results.statement: For a literal physical 3x2 rank-two cross packet with kernel n and a=P n nonzero, ||p_Q||inf <= [5*6^(3/5)/2^(13/10)] Delta^(-2/5)||a||^(-1/5), with continuous density and the same linear interval coefficient.

For a physical triple L and arbitrary-width disjoint original-coordinate bank J with rank A[L,J]=2, Delta the product of its two nonzero singular values and a=A[L,L]n nonzero on the left kernel, ||p_Q||inf <= [5*6^(3/5)/2^(9/10)] Delta^(-2/5)||a||^(-1/5) < 7.852 Delta^(-2/5)||a||^(-1/5), continuously.
For rank-two C=A[L,J], sum_{r<s}||P(c_r x c_s)||^2 = Delta^2||Pn||^2, so the grouped receiver is <=7.852[Delta sqrt(V1_L)]^(-1/5).

partner_applied: fleet04/B09 physical 3x3 cross theorem applied to A=[[0,I3],[I3,0]], giving ||p_Q||inf<=3.
